Apple (AAPL) Holder Bouchey Financial Group LTD Has Lowered Its Stake by $9.39 Million; Continental Resources (CLR) Shares Rose While Waratah Capital Advisors LTD Has Cut by $1.59 Million Its Stake
April 30, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Bouchey Financial Group Ltd decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 71.03% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bouchey Financial Group Ltd sold 55,586 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 22,675 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.84M, down from 78,261 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bouchey Financial Group Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $823.61B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $1.9 during the last trading session, reaching $162.32. About 35.66 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Brad Dunkley decreased its stake in Continental Resources Inc (CLR) by 8.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Waratah Capital Advisors Ltd sold 30,578 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.33% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Brad Dunkley held 340,633 shares of the energy company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.04M, down from 371,211 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Waratah Capital Advisors Ltd who had been investing in Continental Resources Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $24.25 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.02% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $65.17. About 1.77 million shares traded. Continental Resources, Inc. (NYSE:CLR) has risen 34.29% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 22.74% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 14.97 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
